.highlight pre, pre.declarations: background: rgba(228, 230, 235, 0.5); border-radius: 16px; font-size: 85%; line-height: 1.45; overflow: auto; padding: 16px;

.button_btn-primary.declarations: background: rgb(255, 1, 62); border: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); color: rgb(255, 255, 255);

.form_error-msg.declarations: color: rgb(240, 0, 57); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; margin: 12px auto; transform: translateY(-2px);

.wap-atlas-drawer_deleteButton.declarations: align-items: center; background: none; border: 0px; color: rgb(175, 179, 185); display: inline-flex; flex: 0 0 28px; height: 28px; justify-content: center; padding: 0px; width: 28px;

.wap-atlas-drawer_deleteMask.declarations: align-items: center; background: rgba(20, 24, 32, 0.2); display: flex; inset: 0px; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; position: fixed; z-index: 10000;

.wap-atlas-drawer_deleteDialog.declarations: background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 16px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 16px; width: min(100%, 320px);

.wap-atlas-drawer_deleteTitle.declarations: color: rgb(20, 24, 32); font-family: "SF Pro", sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; margin: 0px;

.wap-atlas-drawer_deleteDesc.declarations: color: rgb(109, 116, 130); font-family: "SF Pro", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.45; margin: 8px 0px 0px;

.wap-atlas-drawer_deleteActions.declarations: display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; margin-top: 14px;

.wap-atlas-drawer_cancelDeleteBtn, .wap-.declarations: border: 0px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: "SF Pro", sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; height: 36px; min-width: 88px; padding: 0px 14px;

.header_deleteBtn.declarations: align-items: center; background: none; border: 0px; border-radius: 8px; color: rgb(175, 179, 185); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; flex: 0 0 28px; height: 28px; justify-content: center; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.15s; visibility: hidden; width: 28px;
